body:
## Answers to open questions

### 1. Reader
CamCraft ships 15 post scripts in `assets/posts/*.cps` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`, `BUILTINS`).
These scripts cover milling, turning, plasma, wire EDM, and sinker EDM.
A pure-Rust parser reads RS-274/NGC (NISTIR 6556) and ISO 6983 / DIN 66025 programs.
The parser outputs `cl::Toolpath` sections (`crates/cl/src/cl/path.rs`) and a 1-based line map.

**Slice 1 reads 3-axis ISO milling words (`fanuc.cps`, `haas.cps`, `tormach.cps`, `grblhal.cps`, `tinyg.cps`, `carvera.cps`):**
- **Motion (Group 1):** `G0` rapid, `G1` feed, `G2` CW arc, `G3` CCW arc, and `G80` cycle cancel.
- **Plane (Group 2):** `G17` (XY), `G18` (XZ), and `G19` (YZ) map to `cl::ArcPlane`.
- **Distance mode (Group 3):** `G90` (absolute) and `G91` (incremental).
- **Arc center mode:** `G90.1` (absolute `I/J/K`) and `G91.1` (incremental `I/J/K`).
  Each dialect profile sets its default arc center mode (`G91.1` for Fanuc, Haas, LinuxCNC, and grblHAL).
- **Arcs:** The reader supports `I`/`J`/`K` center offsets and `R` radius words (`R > 0` for minor arcs, `R < 0` for major arcs).
  The reader refuses full-circle `R` blocks and radius errors above tolerance.
- **Units (Group 6):** `G20` (inch, factor `25.4`) and `G21` (mm, factor `1.0`).
- **Feed mode (Group 5):** `G94` (units per minute).
- **Canned cycles (Group 1 and Group 10):** `G73`, `G81`, `G82`, `G83`, `G84`, `G86`, `G89`, and `G98`/`G99` retract modes.
  The reader expands each cycle hole into explicit `cl::Move` chains (`crates/sim/src/sim.rs` uses the move chain as truth).
- **Tool changes and offsets:** `T` numbers, `M6`, `G43 H` (tool length), `G49`, `S`, and `M3`/`M4`/`M5`.
- **Work offsets and reference moves:** `G54`..`G59`, `G53` (machine coordinates), `G28`, and `G30` (when the machine states a reference point).
- **Modal and control words:** `G4` dwell, `G61`/`G64`, `M0`/`M1`/`M2`/`M30`, coolant (`M7`/`M8`/`M9`/`M88`/`M89`), and `%` / `O` headers.

**Later dialect slices cover:**
- **Other mill dialects:** Siemens 840D (`sinumerik.cps`: `G700`/`G710`, `T.. D.. M6`, `CYCLE832`, `;` comments), Mazak (`mazak.cps`: `MOTON`/`MOTOFF`), and Doosan (`doosan-dnm.cps`: `G5.1`, `M10`/`M11`).
  Heidenhain DIN/ISO (`heidenhain.cps`: `.I`) uses `%.. G71 *`, `N.. *`, separate absolute `I/J` blocks, `G200`/`G205`/`G206`/`G207`, `M99`, and `G247`.
- **Heidenhain conversational (KLAR):** `heidenhain.cps` currently emits DIN/ISO only.
  A separate KLAR reader parses `BEGIN PGM`, `TOOL CALL`, `L`, `CC`, `C`, `CR`, `CYCL DEF`, and `CYCL CALL`.
- **Lathe (`fanuc-lathe.cps`, `tormach-lathe.cps`):** `G18` XZ plane, `G7`/`G8` diameter X, `G95`/`G99` feed per rev, `G96`/`G97`, `T0101`, and `G32`/`G33`/`G76`.
- **Wire EDM (`wire-iso.cps`, Sodick):** `G0`/`G1`/`G2`/`G3`, `U`/`V` taper words, and `.mch` `edm.codes`.
  `crates/app/src/stock_sim_wire.rs` routes wire cuts to `verify::wire`, not dexel stock.
- **Subprograms and macros:** `M98`/`M99` local subprograms and bounded Fanuc Macro B (`#` variables, `IF`/`GOTO`, `G65`).
  `crates/post/tests/macro_b/` already models a test-only Macro B subset.

**The reader refuses these inputs by name with the line number:**
- Unknown G, M, or address letters.
- Active `G41`/`G42` cutter radius compensation until the compensation slice lands.
- Macros, `#` variables, `G65`, and `M98` until the subprogram/macro slice lands.
- Probing moves (`G31`, `G38.2`), `G43.4` RTCP, and `A`/`B`/`C` words until the multi-axis slice lands.
- `G28`/`G30`/`G53` moves when the machine does not state a safe reference point.
- `G70`/`G71` on Sinumerik when feed units remain ambiguous (`sinumerik.cps` requires `G700`/`G710`).

### 2. Tools
Machine `.mch` files store `tool_count`, `max_tool_length`, `max_tool_diameter`, `spindle_mount`, and `default_holder` (`crates/post/src/machine/def.rs`).
They do not store a magazine tool table with cutter geometry.
Documents map tool numbers in `tool_numbers::numbers` (`crates/app/src/tool_numbers.rs`).
Tool library `.camtools` files store `LibraryTool` rows (`crates/app/src/tool_library.rs`).

**Resolution flow:**
1. Match each `T<n>` in the NC file against the open document's tool numbers.
2. Allow the user or CLI/MCP caller to pass a `.camtools` library or an explicit `T -> tool` map.
3. Refuse any unmapped `T<n>` before simulation starts, and return the missing `T` list so the UI can prompt the user.
4. Never invent default cutter geometry, because a wrong diameter hides gouges and collisions.

### 3. Setup
The runner reads stock, optional target models, fixtures, WCS origin (`G54`..`G59`), and the mounted `.mch` from the active setup (`crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs`, `crates/app/src/setup_wcs.rs`).
The caller can also pass or override stock, model, fixtures, and WCS origin when opening the NC file.
The runner converts NC coordinates back to world millimeters (`world = wcs_origin + axis_sign * program_mm`), which reverses `posting::wcs_context` and `post::invert` (`crates/post/src/post/invert.rs`).
Material simulation refuses a setup with no stock by name (`stock_sim::stock_grid`).
When the setup has no target model, simulation runs stock removal, fixture collision checks, and machine checks, and reports part gouges as unjudged.

### 4. Multi-axis
`crates/cl/src/cl/pose.rs` defines the canonical tool pose vector (`angles_to_axis`).
Upstream PR #2056 (`camcraft_post::kinematics`: `forward_machine`, `forward_part`) and issue #1962 (PR #2162: rotary `pivot`, `offset`, `zero_offset`, `rollover`, `controller.rtcp`) define the AC trunnion kinematics model.
Note that this fork checkout sits at `v0.19.0`, before #2056 merged upstream.

**Multi-axis design:**
- Slice 1 refuses `A`/`B`/`C` words by name.
- Under `G43.4` (RTCP active), `X Y Z` locate the tool tip in the work frame, and `A B C` map through the `.mch` rotary chain to `Move::axis`.
- On non-RTCP machines (`controller.rtcp = false`), forward kinematics (`forward_part` / `forward_machine`, the reverse of #2056's IK) transforms machine `(X, Y, Z, A, B, C)` into part-frame tip coordinates and `Move::axis` (or `Move::rotary` for 4th-axis work).
- `G93` inverse-time feeds convert to linear rates (`feed_mm_min = move_length_mm * F`) for `sim::Traverse`.
- Posed and rotary moves run through the field engine (`Stock::simulate_display`, `simulate_rotary_slice`) and `verify` posed/solid laws (`solid_hits`, `bands_vs_fixtures_held`, `rapids_vs_fixtures_held`).
- The runner reports that the dexel column verdict does not judge tilted moves (`stock_sim::refuse_unjudged`).

### 5. Units and errors
- **Units:** The reader handles `G20` (inch), `G21` (mm), and Siemens `G700`/`G710` (`G70`/`G71` on Heidenhain headers).
  It multiplies linear coordinates, arc offsets, radii, and feed rates by `25.4` in inch mode.
  It never scales angles (`A`/`B`/`C`), spindle RPM (`S`), tool numbers (`T`), or dwell times (`P`).
  The reader refuses motion coordinates that appear before a unit statement unless the caller provides a fallback unit.
- **Errors:** The reader returns a structured error with the 1-based line number and offending token on any syntax, modal, unit, or geometry failure.
  Each `cl::Move` maps to its 1-based source line so `verify` warnings, `machine::judge` errors, and `gcode_view` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/gcode_view.rs`) highlight the exact NC line.

### 6. Use of it (compare mode)
`crates/app/tests/conformance.rs` checks byte-exact output for the 10 mill posts on the 13 `.cl` goldens.
A round-trip compare mode checks the posted output back through the reader:
1. Post a `Toolpath` with a built-in `.cps` via `camcraft_post::post::engine::run_program_with`.
2. Read the NC output back with `camcraft-gcode` using that post's dialect profile, `.mch`, and WCS origin.
3. Compare move endpoints, rapid/cut types, and arc chord tolerances (allowing TinyG half-turn splits and Heidenhain vertical-arc chords).
4. Simulate both the source `Toolpath` and the read-back `Toolpath` in `camcraft_sim::stock_sim::Dexel` and assert matching stock surfaces within output rounding tolerance.
5. Verify that `PostOutput::line_map` agrees with the reader's line map.

### 7. Where it lives
Follow the crate boundaries in `AGENTS.md` and `docs/M4.1-CRATE-SPLIT.md`:
- **`crates/gcode` (`camcraft-gcode`):** Pure domain crate beside `crates/post`.
  It depends only on `camcraft-cl`, `camcraft-geometry`, and `thiserror` (no `boa_engine`, no `flecs_ecs`).
  Callers pass dialect and machine-kinematics values in, which avoids a new `camcraft-post` dependency edge.
- **`crates/app`:** Holds NC simulation and verification (`Dexel`, `deviate`, `verify::solid_hits`, `bands_vs_fixtures_held`, `rapids_vs_fixtures_held`, `machine::judge`), tool and setup binding, the open-NC command, the `simulate_gcode` MCP tool (`crates/app/src/mcp/`), and `camcraft-cli` support (`crates/app/src/cli.rs`).
- **`crates/ui`:** Holds the open-NC dialog, missing-tool prompt, and playback/viewer wiring (`PlayWorker`, `FieldPlay`, `gcode_view`, `shell::gcode_segment`).

---

## Design proposal

Build the feature in four vertical slices.
Ship an end-to-end 3-axis ISO loop first, then add dialects and kinematics.

1. **Slice 1 (Minimal useful core): `camcraft-gcode` 3-axis ISO reader + `app` sim/verify + MCP/UI playback.**
   Parse core RS-274 3-axis milling G-code into `cl::Toolpath` plus a line map.
   Bind `T<n>` tools and setup data, run `Dexel`/`deviate` + region-free `verify` + `machine::judge`, and wire `simulate_gcode` into MCP, CLI, and UI (`PlayWorker` + `gcode_view`).
2. **Slice 2 (Mill dialects + round-trip compare):**
   Add dialect profiles for `sinumerik`, `heidenhain` DIN/ISO (`.I`), `mazak`, and `doosan-dnm`.
   Add the round-trip compare mode and test suite across all 10 built-in milling posts.
3. **Slice 3 (Cutter comp + Multi-axis):**
   Add `G41`/`G42`/`G40` cutter radius compensation offsetting.
   Add 4th/5th-axis `A`/`B`/`C` words, `G43.4` RTCP, `G93`, and forward kinematics (`camcraft_post::kinematics`), using `FieldPlay` and posed `verify` laws.
4. **Slice 4 (Macros + Turning + KLAR + Wire EDM):**
   Add `M98`/`M99` subprograms and bounded Macro B, 2-axis lathe dialects (`stock_sim::lathe`), Heidenhain KLAR conversational (`.H`), and Wire EDM ISO / Sodick (`verify::wire`).

---

## Sub-issues

1. **gcode: create camcraft-gcode crate for RS-274/ISO 6983 3-axis milling**
   - What: Adds the pure-Rust `crates/gcode` (`camcraft-gcode`) crate to parse 3-axis ISO milling NC files into `cl::Toolpath` sections and a 1-based line map.
   - Done means: `camcraft-gcode` parses `G0`-`G3`, `G17`-`G19`, `G20`/`G21`, `G90`/`G91`, `G90.1`/`G91.1`, `I`/`J`/`K` and `R` arcs, `G73`/`G80`-`G89` cycles, `G54`-`G59`, `T`/`M6`, and `G43`/`G49`, and tests pin named line-numbered refusals for unsupported words.
   - Proposed: `P6` | `effort:max` | `area:post`, `area:sim`

2. **app: simulate and verify external NC programs against setup stock, model, fixtures, and machine**
   - What: Adds the NC-import simulation runner and command in `crates/app` to map `T` numbers, transform WCS coordinates, and run `Dexel`/`deviate`, region-free `verify`, and `machine::judge` checks.
   - Done means: An integration test simulates a 3-axis NC file against stock, target model, fixtures, and `.mch`, refuses unmapped tools or missing stock by name, reports line-numbered findings, and builds a `PlaySeed`.
   - Proposed: `P6` | `effort:high` | `area:sim`, `area:post`

3. **MCP: add simulate_gcode tool and CLI command for external NC simulation**
   - What: Exposes external NC file parsing, tool mapping, verification findings, and stock rendering through `simulate_gcode` in `crates/app/src/mcp/` and `camcraft-cli`.
   - Done means: An MCP test runs `simulate_gcode` on an `.nc` fixture with tool bindings, returns JSON findings with line numbers, and renders the simulated stock via `render_stock` (refusing unmapped tools with `isError: true`).
   - Proposed: `P5` | `effort:medium` | `area:mcp`

4. **ui: open NC file, map T-numbers, and play back stock removal with line highlight**
   - What: Adds the GUI open-NC workflow (`File -> Open G-code`), unmapped-tool prompt, and `PlayWorker` + `gcode_view` synchronization for external `.nc`/`.tap`/`.gcode`/`.i` files.
   - Done means: Structural and `egui_kittest` UI tests open an NC fixture, map a `T` number, run `FieldPlay` playback and Deviate, and highlight the active NC line segment via `gcode_segment`.
   - Proposed: `P6` | `effort:high` | `area:ui`, `area:sim`

5. **gcode: read Siemens 840D, Heidenhain DIN/ISO, Mazak, and Doosan mill dialects**
   - What: Adds dialect profiles in `camcraft-gcode` for `sinumerik` (`G700`/`G710`, `T.. D..`, `CYCLE832`), `heidenhain` DIN/ISO (`.I` `%.. G71 *`, `N.. *`, separate `I/J`, `G200`/`G205`/`G206`/`G207`/`M99`, `G247`), `mazak` (`MOTON`/`MOTOFF`), and `doosan-dnm` (`G5.1`, `M10`/`M11`).
   - Done means: Tests parse programs from all four dialects into accurate `cl::Toolpath` chains and refuse dialect mismatches (such as Sinumerik `G70`/`G71` feed ambiguity) with the line number.
   - Proposed: `P6` | `effort:high` | `area:post`

6. **post: add round-trip G-code compare mode and test suite across built-in mill posts**
   - What: Adds a post-then-read compare runner and test suite that posts `.cl` goldens through all 10 built-in mill posts, parses them back, and checks geometry and `Dexel` stock equivalence.
   - Done means: Every built-in milling post passes round-trip geometric and `Dexel` stock comparison against the 13 `.cl` goldens in `crates/app/tests/`, plus line-map parity with `PostOutput::line_map`.
   - Proposed: `P6` | `effort:high` | `area:post`, `area:sim`

7. **gcode: support cutter radius compensation (G41/G42/G40) in external NC simulation**
   - What: Adds 2D cutter radius compensation offsetting (`G41`/`G42`/`G40` with `D` register or bound tool radius) in `camcraft-gcode` so control-compensated contours simulate at cutter center.
   - Done means: Tests verify `G41`/`G42` lead-in, contour offsetting, corner transitions, and `G40` cancel against CamCraft's own `contour_control_comp.nc` golden, and refuse invalid engage/cancel blocks with line numbers.
   - Proposed: `P6` | `effort:max` | `area:post`, `area:sim`

8. **gcode: support multi-axis A/B/C words, G43.4 RTCP, G93, and forward kinematics**
   - What: Extends `camcraft-gcode` and `app` NC sim to parse `A`/`B`/`C` rotary words, `G93` inverse-time feeds, `G43.4` RTCP, and non-RTCP forward kinematics (`camcraft_post::kinematics`) into posed/rotary `Move`s.
   - Done means: Tests round-trip 4th-axis indexed/rotary and 5-axis RTCP/trunnion NC files into `Move::axis`/`Move::rotary`, run `FieldPlay` and `verify` posed/solid checks, and report that the column verdict does not judge tilted moves.
   - Proposed: `P6` | `effort:max` | `area:multiaxis`, `area:sim`

9. **gcode: support M98/M99 subprograms and bounded Fanuc Macro B expressions**
   - What: Adds bounded local/external subprogram calls (`M98`/`M99` with loop count `L`) and Fanuc Macro B variables, expressions, and `IF`/`GOTO`/`WHILE` control flow with step limits.
   - Done means: Tests expand subprograms and Macro B loops into `cl::Toolpath` moves with caller/callee line mapping, and refuse infinite loops or vacant `#` variable reads with the line number.
   - Proposed: `P7` | `effort:max` | `area:post`

10. **gcode: support 2-axis lathe dialects (G7/G8, G95/G99, G32/G33/G76) in turning sim**
    - What: Adds turning dialect parsing (`G18` XZ, `G7`/`G8` diameter X, `G95`/`G99` rev feed, `G96`/`G97`, `T0101`, `G32`/`G33`/`G76`) and connects it to `stock_sim::lathe` in the field engine.
    - Done means: Tests read back `fanuc-lathe.cps` and `tormach-lathe.cps` golden programs and simulate revolved stock removal via `Stock::simulate_lathe_profile`.
    - Proposed: `P7` | `effort:high` | `area:turning`, `area:post`

11. **gcode: support Heidenhain KLAR conversational (.H) dialect**
    - What: Adds a Heidenhain KLAR conversational parser (`BEGIN PGM`, `TOOL CALL`, `L`, `CC`, `C`, `CR`, `CYCL DEF`, `CYCL CALL`, `END PGM`) emitting `cl::Toolpath` moves and line mappings.
    - Done means: Tests parse KLAR conversational programs with lines, polar/center arcs, and drilling cycles into `cl::Toolpath` and refuse unsupported cycles by name and block number.
    - Proposed: `P7` | `effort:max` | `area:post`

12. **gcode: support Wire EDM ISO and Sodick taper (U/V) files for wire verification**
    - What: Adds Wire EDM dialect parsing (`wire-iso` and Sodick `G0`-`G3`, `U`/`V` taper offsets, and `.mch` `edm.codes`) feeding `verify::wire` path checks instead of milling dexel stock.
    - Done means: Tests read back `wire-iso.cps` golden programs and Sodick `U`/`V` taper blocks into wire paths checked by `crates/sim/src/verify/wire/`, refusing missing `edm.codes` by line number.
    - Proposed: `P8` | `effort:high` | `area:post`, `area:sim`

We filed 12 concrete sub-issues for this research:

- #2217 — `gcode: create camcraft-gcode crate for RS-274/ISO 6983 3-axis milling` (`P6`, `effort:max`, `area:post`, `area:sim`)
- #2218 — `app: simulate and verify external NC programs against setup stock, model, fixtures, and machine` (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:sim`, `area:post`)
- #2220 — `MCP: add simulate_gcode tool and CLI command for external NC simulation` (`P5`, `effort:medium`, `area:mcp`)
- #2221 — `ui: open NC file, map T-numbers, and play back stock removal with line highlight` (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:ui`, `area:sim`)
- #2219 — `gcode: read Siemens 840D, Heidenhain DIN/ISO, Mazak, and Doosan mill dialects` (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
- #2222 — `post: add round-trip G-code compare mode and test suite across built-in mill posts` (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `area:sim`)
- #2223 — `gcode: support cutter radius compensation (G41/G42/G40) in external NC simulation` (`P6`, `effort:max`, `area:post`, `area:sim`)
- #2224 — `gcode: support multi-axis A/B/C words, G43.4 RTCP, G93, and forward kinematics` (`P6`, `effort:max`, `area:multiaxis`, `area:sim`)
- #2225 — `gcode: support M98/M99 subprograms and bounded Fanuc Macro B expressions` (`P7`, `effort:max`, `area:post`)
- #2226 — `gcode: support 2-axis lathe dialects (G7/G8, G95/G99, G32/G33/G76) in turning sim` (`P7`, `effort:high`, `area:turning`, `area:post`)
- #2227 — `gcode: support Heidenhain KLAR conversational (.H) dialect` (`P7`, `effort:max`, `area:post`)
- #2228 — `gcode: support Wire EDM ISO and Sodick taper (U/V) files for wire verification` (`P8`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `area:sim`)

This umbrella issue stays open for maintainer review.

Research complete: every open question is answered and the sub-issues are filed (listed in the comments above; a research pass on 2026-11-23 re-checked both). Closing the umbrella per AGENTS.md "needs-research is research, not code" - only the sub-issues are picked for code.
